preconditions.description: The dimensions of the land plot must be at least 3x3 and at most 300x300.
The desired time t must be a positive integer not exceeding 10^9.
The time values for flat ground, ascent, and descent must be positive integers not exceeding 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= h <= 10**6 for row in heights for h in row)
preconditions.description: All height values in the land plot must be positive integers not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must be the coordinates of the upper left and lower right corners of the chosen rectangle.
The time ts of passing the selected track must be as close to t as possible.

postconditions.expression: r1 >= 1 and c1 >= 1 and r2 <= n and c2 <= m
postconditions.description: The coordinates of the rectangle must be within the bounds of the land plot.
All sides of the rectangle must consist of no less than three squares.

candidate_issues.instruction: Add a postcondition to ensure that the time ts of passing the selected track is calculated correctly based on the movement rules.
candidate_issues.task_evidence: If a biathlete moves from a higher square to a lower one, he makes a descent. If a biathlete moves from a lower square to a higher one, he makes an ascent. If a biathlete moves between two squares with the same height, then he moves on flat ground.
